content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I know users can set timers and counters. Is there a way to set a marker or input parameter to enable or disable functions? Thank you.
It’s unclear from your description what exactly you want to achieve. Could you provide a specific example of your requirements?

I have a machine with a fan. If the user enables the fan through [product_name] parameters, the internal procedure will start and stop the fan output as needed. If the user disables a marker or parameter in [product_name], then the procedure will not activate the fan during operation. Thanks.
That’s still not a precise example. Please upload your program as a ZIP file and explain which blocks you are referring to.

Thanks for your response. I am sending a simple example from my project, where the marker indicated by the red arrow should be set by the user using the [product_name] screen, similarly to how counters and timers are configured.
It’s not possible to directly switch on a flag through the [product_name] display. This can only be done remotely.
Hi [user_name], if you use a software switch instead of a marker combined with an AND link, it can be switched via the display.
Thank you so much for your assistance. Could you suggest an example of a software switch?
The software switch is called LSC Softkey. You can configure this block as either a button or a switch.
Thanks, I will look for online tutorials or instructions since I haven’t worked with that before.
You need to call the softkey in a message text so users can operate it.

analysis.insight_summary: The user wants a manual way to enable or disable a function (like a fan) within a [product_name] application using the product’s display, similar to how timers and counters are managed. The discussion clarifies that direct flag or marker switching on the display is not supported and can only be done remotely. An alternative using a configurable software switch (LSC Softkey) is suggested, showing a mismatch between standard user expectations and the available options.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to be able to set or reset markers and flags directly via the [product_name] display, just as they can with counters and timers, to control machine functions.
